metadata.title: LLM-in-Finance-Economics network: foundation technology → reusable function → workflow/asset task
metadata.scope: LLM-in-Finance-Economics functionality; not a pedagogy or Study Planner taxonomy.

groups.L2: data_knowledge; analytics; decision; action; simulation_learning; controls_governance
groups.L3: workflow/domain tasks with asset_class and workflow_stage fields

edge_semantics.requires: functional prerequisite; use only when necessary
edge_semantics.risk_propagates: failure/risk path; not a causal efficacy claim

metadata.evidence_policy: E012 OMI homepage is context-only. Domain finance/economics edges are hypothesis unless a specific source is attached. Generic LLM/agent foundations use cited papers/docs from project research.

two_hop_task_reachability.caveat: Reachability reflects graph density and edge typing, not empirical validity.

scorecard_denominators.note: These are distinct audit scorecards; do not compare their bucket counts as one denominator.

two_hop_task_reachability.caveat: Reachability reflects graph density and edge typing, not empirical validity.

scorecard_denominators.note: These are distinct audit scorecards; do not compare their bucket counts as one denominator.

metadata.metric_catalog: metrics.csv includes domain/function/evidence coverage, PIT leakage, extraction/citation, forecast calibration/utility, Sharpe/Sortino/drawdown/turnover/exposure, VaR/ES/stress/hedge, valuation, portfolio/attribution, execution/TCA/market-making, compliance/KYC/AML/surveillance/reporting, simulation, training/scaling/inference, and governance/privacy/incident metrics.

gaps.missing_or_weak: No known orphan functions; optional/precedes edges separate controls.

gaps.existing_nodes: Specific evidence on generic agent/LLM foundations
gaps.missing_or_weak: OMI homepage is context only; finance mappings remain hypotheses.
gaps.recommendation: Attach domain papers/datasets before asserting efficacy
gaps.risk_if_unresolved: Many finance edges intentionally remain hypothesis.

gaps.existing_nodes: Document QA, forecast, valuation, risk, portfolio, execution, market making, central-bank, compliance, research, simulation and governance tasks
gaps.missing_or_weak: Add asset-specific variants as data sources become available.
gaps.risk_if_unresolved: Coverage is structural, not evidence of performance.

gaps.existing_nodes: Scaling, distributed, FlashAttention, quantization, MoE, speculative, long context and vLLM nodes
gaps.risk_if_unresolved: Foundation presence is not production validation.

gaps.missing_or_weak: Attach official regulatory rulebooks and labeled cases.
gaps.risk_if_unresolved: Hypothesis until domain sources and labels are attached.

gaps.existing_nodes: Causal macro function and CB-COMMS task
gaps.missing_or_weak: Attach econometric/central-bank publications and identification protocol.

gaps.requirement: Risk backtests, utility and cost metrics
gaps.missing_or_weak: Require held-out walk-forward and confidence intervals.
gaps.recommendation: Do not treat generic task success as economic utility

audit_summary.method: Finance-aware proxy: 20% raw degree + 25% cross-layer degree + 35% downstream task reach + 10% risk degree + 10% feedback degree; proxy is not economic importance.
